description: book an appointment with a doctor
utterances: can i get in to see someone this week for a sore knee
I've been having stomach pain for two weeks and would like to come in and have a doctor take a look, what's the soonest opening you have?

description: move an existing appointment to a different time
utterances: something came up thursday can we push my visit to next week
I have a visit booked for Monday morning but my work schedule changed, is there any chance I could switch it to an afternoon later in the week instead?

description: cancel an upcoming appointment
utterances: i need to drop my visit on friday, not coming anymore
The issue I was going to be seen for has cleared up on its own, so please take me off the schedule for next Tuesday.

description: get notified if an earlier appointment opens up
utterances: my slot is three weeks out, can you call me if anything sooner frees up
I already have a date booked but it's quite far away and I'd rather be seen sooner, could you put me on a list for cancellations?

description: confirm the date and time of my appointment
utterances: wait is my checkup tomorrow at nine or ten
I got a reminder text but I deleted it by accident, can you tell me exactly when I'm supposed to come in and which building it's at?

description: set up a remote video visit instead of coming in
utterances: can i just do this one over video, i cant get to the clinic
I'm stuck at home with a bad cold and don't want to spread it in the waiting room, could the doctor see me over a call instead?

description: be seen by the doctor i saw last time
utterances: i want the lady who saw me last month not a different doc
The physician I had at my previous visit already knows my history and I'd prefer to continue with her, can you make sure my next booking is with her?

description: schedule a routine yearly physical exam
utterances: its been about a year, time for my regular once over
Nothing is wrong with me, I just haven't had a general health check since last spring and want to get the usual full workup done soon.

description: request a repeat of my regular medication
utterances: running low on my blood pressure pills need more
I take the same tablets every day for my thyroid and I only have about five days left, can the doctor send another supply to my usual pharmacy?

description: change which pharmacy my prescription is sent to
utterances: can you send my script to the pharmacy near my office instead
I recently moved and the drugstore you have on file is now really far from me, please route my next fill to the one closer to my new place.

description: pharmacy has no record of my prescription
utterances: went to pick up my meds and they said nothing was sent over
The doctor told me yesterday she would send my antibiotics electronically, but when I got to the counter this morning they couldn't find anything under my name.

description: tell the doctor a medication is causing problems
utterances: the new tablets make me dizzy all day, someone needs to know
Since starting the pills I was given last week I've had constant nausea and trouble sleeping, and I'd like the doctor to review whether I should keep taking them.

description: find out whether my refill request was approved
utterances: did the doc sign off on my repeat yet or still waiting
I put in a request for more of my inhaler three days ago through the portal and haven't heard anything back, can you check where it's sitting?

description: receive the results of a recent test
utterances: had bloods done monday, are they back yet
I gave a urine sample and had blood drawn at my last visit and was told to check back after a week, could you send me whatever came through?

description: book time with the doctor to go over my results
utterances: got my numbers in the portal but i dont get them, can someone walk me through
My report came back with a couple of values flagged in red and no explanation, I'd like a phone slot with the physician to talk about what they mean.

description: results are taking longer than i was told
utterances: they said two days for the test, its been a week and nothing
When I had the biopsy done the nurse promised I'd hear within five working days, that was over two weeks ago and the portal still shows it as pending.

description: book a time to have samples taken
utterances: doc ordered bloodwork, when can i come in and get it drawn
My specialist gave me a form for a set of tests and said your lab handles them, I'd like to arrange an early morning slot before work.

description: find out how to prepare before my test
utterances: do i have to skip breakfast before the blood draw tomorrow
I'm booked for an ultrasound of my abdomen next week and nobody told me whether I need to fast, drink water beforehand, or stop any of my usual medication.

description: get referred to a specialist
utterances: my gp said i should see a dermatologist, how do i get that set up
I've had ongoing back pain for months and the usual treatment isn't helping, I'd like the doctor to send me on to someone who deals with spines.

description: find out whether my referral has been sent
utterances: has the cardiology letter gone out yet, they havent called me
Last month the doctor said she'd refer me to an ear specialist, but the specialist's office says they have nothing from you, can you check if it was submitted?

description: get a new referral because the old one ran out
utterances: my referral to the physio lapsed, need a fresh one
The specialist won't see me because the paperwork you sent last year was only valid for twelve months, could the doctor issue an updated one without me coming in?

description: get a copy of my own medical file
utterances: i want everything you have on me printed out or emailed
I'm applying for a visa and they need my full health history from your clinic, what's the process to request the complete file and how long does it take?

description: forward my records to a different clinic
utterances: im switching to a new practice, can you send my file over to them
I'm moving to another city next month and have already registered with a doctor there, they've asked that my history be forwarded directly to their office.

description: fix wrong information in my file
utterances: my chart says im allergic to penicillin and im not, fix it
When I looked at my summary on the portal it lists a surgery I never had and the wrong date of birth, I need those entries amended.

description: get proof of the vaccines i have received
utterances: need a printout of my shots for my new job
My daughter's school is asking for an official immunization history before she can enroll, can you provide a stamped document listing everything she's had with you?

description: understand what the charges on my bill are for
utterances: why is there a facility fee on here i only saw the nurse
The statement I received has three line items for one visit and the total is far more than I was quoted, can someone go through each item with me?

description: contest a charge for something that was never done
utterances: im being billed for an xray i never got, take it off
My invoice includes a physiotherapy session on a date when I was actually out of the country, so that entry must belong to someone else and needs removing.

description: pay a large bill in monthly installments
utterances: cant pay the whole surgery bill at once, can i split it up
The amount owed after my hospital stay is more than I can manage right now, I'd like to arrange smaller regular payments spread over the next several months.

description: get a detailed receipt to submit to my insurer
utterances: my insurance wants a breakdown of the visit not just the total
I paid for my consultation upfront and now my health plan is refusing to reimburse me without a document showing each procedure code and its cost separately.

description: change the insurance details the clinic has for me
utterances: i switched plans in january, you still have the old one
My employer moved everyone to a different coverage provider and I want to give you the new policy information before my next visit so the claim goes through.

description: get a doctor's note excusing me from work
utterances: boss wants proof i was actually sick last week
I was seen on Wednesday for the flu and had to miss three days, my employer requires a signed letter from the doctor confirming I was unfit to work.

description: sign up as a new patient at the clinic
utterances: just moved to the area, are you taking new people
I've never been to your practice before and would like to join as a regular patient, what forms do I need to fill out and what should I bring?
